name: Media Converter
description: Batch format conversion and compression for video and image assets, powered by FFmpeg.
author: Dolag

commands.title: 格式转换…
commands.when: selection.assetCount == selection.count && selection.assetCount != 0 && (selection.extensions intersects ['mp4','mov','mkv','webm','avi','m4v','ts','mts','m2ts'] || selection.extensions intersects ['jpg','jpeg','png','webp','bmp','tif','tiff','gif','avif'])

commands.title: 压缩…
commands.when: selection.assetCount == selection.count && selection.assetCount != 0 && (selection.extensions intersects ['mp4','mov','mkv','webm','avi','m4v','ts','mts','m2ts'] || selection.extensions intersects ['jpg','jpeg','png','webp','bmp','tif','tiff','gif','avif'])
